title: My Grandpa's Radio Plays Tomorrow's News
cta: Tag a friend who'd want to hear tomorrow's news
description:
Grandpa's old radio warned him about tomorrow, and he used it to save a stranger. Then it said his name.
Would YOU listen to tomorrow's news? Tell me in the comments.

A CreepyCartoonTales story.
lines: Grandpa's old radio doesn't play today's news. It plays tomorrow's.
"Ten fifteen tomorrow," it crackled. "A girl on a red bicycle. Mill Road corner. A runaway lorry."
The next morning, Grandpa put on his coat.
At ten fourteen, the girl came flying down the hill.
Grandpa stepped out and grabbed her handlebars.
The lorry thundered past... right where she would have been.
She was shaking. Grandpa was smiling.
That night, the radio crackled again.
"Ten fifteen tomorrow. An old man. Mill Road corner."
Grandpa switched it off and looked at me.
"Whatever happens... don't let me go out tomorrow."
It's ten fourteen. His chair is empty.
